news.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
news.summary: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

news.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
news.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.
